arms.better: The run repeatedly re-read the same decoder and source history, exhausted three attempts without making a change, and escalated without running a test. The failure output did explain that no patch or evidence was submitted, but repeated 'continue with tm --resume S-N' guidance followed by a final 'tm ticket retry T-1' instruction left the recovery path ambiguous. tm should recognize the same no-progress failure across automatic retries, stop spending tokens on duplicate investigations, preserve a compact actionable finding, and present one consistent next command. A much smaller usage footprint and a focused verification attempt would have made this recoverable.

OpenCode found UnmarshalToMap quickly, added leading-BOM trimming and TOML/YAML/JSON regression cases, and ran focused tests successfully. It would be better to check out and verify against the exact merged PR regression-test set before ending: after those test files were overwritten from the merge SHA, the broader command failed to compile because those tests depend on companion production/API changes absent at the base SHA. Calling out that mismatch and distinguishing the focused package pass from the required post-overwrite check would make the verification outcome clearer.
